| "Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds | Unsupported: testimonial with a customer name and location, none supplied or on the allowlist. |

**Issues**

1. **Fake testimonial.** The quote attributed to "Emma, Leeds" is not on the allowlist and no source was given. I can't verify it's a real customer, so it must come out. It is also a superlative ("Best") in a customer's voice, which doesn't make it safer.
2. **Landing page consistency.** Ad claims must also appear on the landing page. I can't see the landing page, so confirm it states the plastic-free and home compostable claims.
3. **Green claims.** "Plastic-free" and "home compostable" are environmental claims, but both are on the allowlist, so they're fine. Keep the wording exactly as is and don't broaden it to "eco-friendly" or "zero waste".

**Compliant version**

Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery over £25.

(Optional proof line: [PROOF NEEDED: real, permissioned customer review if you want a testimonial]. Alternatively, "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" is allowlisted.)

Character counts, if you're working to standard RSA limits (30 for headlines, 90 for descriptions): the headline "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" is 21 characters. The description above is 79 characters. If your platform limits differ, tell me and I'll recount.

Don't publish until the testimonial is removed.
